conbody.p: Extended Rear view Monitor function maintains the rearview of the vehicle when shifting the gear from R (Reverse) to N (Neutral) or D (Drive) to help you park safely.

section.title: Operating conditions
section.p: Rearview Monitor will maintain when the following conditions are satisfied:

li.p: Shifting the gear from R (Reverse) to N (Neutral) or D (Drive).
Your driving speed is below approximately 10 km/h (6 mph).

section.title: Off conditions
section.p: Extended Rearview Monitor function will turn off when one the following conditions are satisfied:

li.p: Pressing the back button (3) on the rear monitor screen
Pressing the infotainment system operation button (4)
The vehicle speed is faster than 10 km/h (6 mph)
